title: FishCrates
description: FishCrates is a new, highly customizable minecraft plugin to add fun to your server with Crate animations, holograms. This is the free version of the plugin
body:
_FishCrates_ - New, highly customizable plugin.

Available commands:

```
/fca menu
```
 - Opens the GUI menu for Admins, you can customize anything in there.

```
/fca give <player> <key> <amount>
```
 - gives player the keys to the crate.

```
/fca take
```
 - Takes keys from player.

```
/fca reload
```
 - Reloads plugin.

```
/crates
```
 - Displays the embed of plugin.

Available PlaceHolders:
FishCrates also supports PlaceHolderAPI, the available placeholder is 
```
%fishcrates_<id>_keys%
```
 - Displays the amount of keys user has. However, such as many plugins, FishCrates **doesnt** automaticly crash when PAPI is not installed.

You can customize **ANYTHING** inside the plugin folder, from crates, main config, to popups.

You can join our **Discord server** for support & updates.
